test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: If 28 ∶ 98 ∶∶ 98 ∶ y, find the value of y.
solution:
Concept used:

If four number a,b,c,d are in proportion

Then we can say that

a / b = c / d 

⇒ a × d = b × c

Calculation:

So the value of y is 

⇒ 98 × 98 / 28 = 343
